hygiene-timer.content:
[Unit]
Description=nova bench hygiene

[Timer]
OnCalendar=daily
Persistent=true

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

mirror-timer.content:
[Unit]
Description=nova git mirror fetch

[Timer]
OnCalendar=*:0/15
Persistent=true

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

runner-1.content:
[Unit]
Description=nova runner 1

[Service]
Environment=PATH=%h/.local/bin:%h/go/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin
Environment=HOME=%h
KillMode=control-group
TimeoutStopSec=30s
ExecStart=%h/nova-bench/harness/current/runner.sh 1
Restart=always

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
